result.title: MMKG-R1: Constructing Multimodal Knowledge Graphs via Reinforcement Learning
result.summary: Multimodal knowledge graphs (MMKGs) organize information across different modalities to support multimodal Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), which aims to improve the performance of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). The effectiveness of these multimodal Graph RAG methods largely depends on the quality of the constructed MMKGs. However, most existing methods construct MMKGs without explicit guidance on graph quality, while reinforcement learning (RL)-based methods that rely on final-answer correctness may provide only indirect feedback on MMKG quality. To address these limitations, we propose MMKG-R1, a novel MMKG-quality-driven RL framework for training an MLLM as a multimodal knowledge constructor. To be specific, MMKG-R1 introduces multiple quality-aware rewards to directly evaluate both the quality of information extracted from individual knowledge sources and the quality of the assembled MMKG. These rewards are then used to guide the RL training. Experiments across multiple datasets show that MMKG-R1 constructs MMKGs that improve downstream question-answering accuracy.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MMKG-R1，用多组质量感知奖励引导强化学习，把 MLLM 训练成多模态知识构建器，以生成支撑多模态 Graph RAG 的高质量多模态知识图谱，并提升下游问答准确率。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「直接评价中间抽取与组装质量而非只看最终答案」的奖励设计，可能为 LVR 中轨迹监督与贡献分配提供线索；但研究目标是知识图谱质量而非推理期 latent 状态的使用，具体可迁移性需核查原文。
